card.title: Sudanese diplomatic staff told to leave within 48 hours
card.body: From Sudan's consulate in Assosa, Benishangul-Gumuz, a senior Ethiopian official told Reuters. No reason was given. It comes days after Sudan filed complaints with the UN Security Council and AU over drone attacks.
